svg.title: pwauto
svg.desc: pwauto: AI-agent-ready UI test automation for any web application. You give an AI agent (Claude Code or Codex) a URL. It runs the stages setup, explore, scenarios, review, automate, heal and report, and stops at each gate for your decision; you approve the scenarios. Expected results come from a sourced knowledge base. Scenarios are plain-English Gherkin on Playwright and TypeScript. Guardrails stop weakened tests, and each run keeps screenshots, video, traces and logs.
